entities.summary: The Musée d'art et d'histoire is an encyclopedic art museum located in Geneva, Switzerland. Its collection comprises more than 650,000 objects spanning archaeology, applied arts, horology, the holdings of the Art and Archaeology Library, and fine and graphic arts, making it one of the largest museum collections in Switzerland.
